notes: Every s### and t### partitioned exactly once.

The chief judgment call is the head of ἐπισκοπῆς → *the office of a bishop*; taken on *office* by rule 91's operational test, the corpus spending *bishop* on ἐπίσκοπος at 1TI.3.2. A head on *bishop* is the competing reading and is named in the unit's note.

Πιστὸς → *Faithful is* follows rule 53: verbless clause with an adjectival predicate, so the supplied copula rides with the predicate adjective and not with the subject noun phrase ὁ λόγος, rule 63 confirming since the subject is a noun.
τις → *a man* heads on the nominal word under rules 22 and 51's anarthrous clause, matching 1TI.3.5 in the same chapter (rule 24).
καλοῦ ἔργου → *a good work* splits under rule 58, the supplied determiner going to the noun discontinuously under rule 15.
